integrity: All formula assertions are supported by an explicit cyclic-block proof and a standalone finite graph-level checker; no independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only simple consecutive cycle powers C_n^r, integers r>=1 and n>=2r+1, labeled matchings. The known maximum induced-matching size is not new. Publication priority provisional, especially for unindexed or inaccessible matching-polynomial literature. Finite verification is not a proof for all parameters.
title: Complete induced- and maximal-induced-matching polynomials of cycle powers
